content_of_post_to_comment: I’d heard that the UK gov were advising households to prep in case of extreme weather disrupting food supply, and I was curious how many months they recommended. But it was just 3 days! I wonder how many people (other than the extremely impoverished) don't have a buffer of 3 days worth of food in their house.
comment: The interesting question may be less about having three days of food and more about how fragile our supply chains have become that a short disruption feels unusual. The gap is between household preparedness and systemic resilience.
